title: Toolshed tool metadata
description: Schema for tools/<tool-name>/tool.json. This is the contract every tool must satisfy. New fields must be added as optional properties so existing tools are never broken (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

id.description: Unique tool identifier. Must be lowercase-kebab-case and must match the tool's directory name (tools/<id>/).

description.description: One or two sentence description of what the tool does.

category.description: Coarse grouping shown on the homepage (e.g. Developer, Text, Image). See CONTRIBUTING.md for the current conventions.

tags.description: Lowercase keywords used for search and discovery.

runtime.description: Where the tool runs. Initially always "browser".

execution.description: Where the tool's logic executes. Initially always "local".

dataUploaded.description: True if the tool ever transmits user input or derived data over the network.

storage.description: Where the tool persists data, if anywhere.
